name: Ranjit Dutta

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ranjit Dutta writes poetry and fiction in Assamese and English and works across languages as a translator. His Assamese lyric collection Xur eti Deana was launched in Margherita in 2019. His collaborations with Rajorshi Patranabis include translation between Assamese and Bengali and the rendering of Assamese poetry into English.

His English poems here question the stability of the self and the consolations of belief. “Ask me Not” moves through distress towards remembered stories and sacred texts, yet its repeated refusal leaves the speaker unsettled. “Humming Of Faith” places cause and effect beside thirst, mirage and dream, allowing faith to remain both a source of sustenance and a question.
